releases.name: OpenCode 2 peer messaging v0.3.0
releases.body:
# OpenCode 2 peer messaging — v0.3.0

An independent OpenCode 2 adaptation of
[jkrandom-sudo/opencode-plugin-peers](https://github.com/jkrandom-sudo/opencode-plugin-peers),
based on upstream 0.2.5. The original authors' MIT licence and credit are preserved.

## Included

- Native OpenCode 2 server and terminal entrypoints.
- Cross-session discovery and plain-text messaging, including busy sessions.
- Durable queues, held messages and final delivery confirmations.
- Native approval rules preserved; no unattended permission override.
- Visible command and menu results, including populated inboxes and outboxes.
- No OpenCode 1 SDK runtime dependency.

Requires OpenCode 2.3.0 or newer.

## Package

The attached `opencode-plugin-peers-v2-0.3.0.tgz` contains the compiled plugin,
documentation and licence. It has been installed and tested from the archive
in a clean directory.

The npm package is
[`opencode-plugin-peers-v2`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-plugin-peers-v2).

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-plugin-peers-v2
```

## Verification

- 87 automated checks passed.
- The packaged archive passed isolated real-server messaging, busy-session
  delivery and native approval-prompt checks.
- Real terminal checks passed for empty and populated inbox/outbox results.
- Held and queued messages survived receiver restarts without duplicate
  delivery; sender restarts preserved final confirmations.
- No paid model calls were used.
- The clean package install reported zero known dependency vulnerabilities.

Abrupt crashes and machine power loss remain untested.
